name: Corsidia
description: Italian course-comparison directory. It picks schools, training bodies and teachers, so users can compare course offers and prices and then contact the organizers directly. Corsidia.org covers publicly funded active-labour-policy training. Free for course seekers. Founded Jan 2018, Italy.

mentions.evidence: MRR $0 / 0 seat subscriptions, ~$78,758 L30, ~$3,115,522 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 5, 2026 ~05:47 Warsaw (03:47 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Build a "compare local course providers" directory for one country/language (PL driving schools, forklift/UDT certs, language schools) and charge providers per lead. SEO pages per city × course type are the product.
